0542Statistics

Metabase (REA environment)

earakely-scale/MetabaseEnv-REA

Answer retrieval questions and edit saved questions in a seeded Metabase analytics instance through 42 API tools.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • tool-calling evaluation on a real app API
  • CI smoke test for an agentenv stack

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Pass or fail

Retrieval tasks score 1 if the response contains the recorded value; write tasks are graded from the environment state through data/get, reward 1 only if all checks pass.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

agent-env hf run earakely-scale/MetabaseEnv-REA --bundle metabase --task smoke          # Docker, no model
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/MetabaseEnv-REA --bundle metabase --eval metabase-retrieval --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq
agent-env hf run earakely-scale/MetabaseEnv-REA --bundle metabase --eval metabase-writes --model openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/MetabaseEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir MetabaseEnv-REA

Needs: Docker; model endpoint for the evals.
